pages.text: A non-difficult boss that drops items useful for killing other, more difficult bosses.$(br)Lives in Nether.

pages.title: Eye of Monstrous
pages.text: It is necessary to search for the Forge of Souls.

Usually his monastery can be found just walking along the Nether.$(br2)As soon as you approach the Monster, it will wake up.$(br2)The boss uses devastating attacks from close range, sometimes shooting lava when the target is too far away. After a few lava throws,

he will start sucking it nearby to recharge. Sucking in the lava heals him, so try to keep him away from it. When his health drops below 33%, he becomes enraged and begins to attack more often.$(br2)As a result, we can say that to defeat him
You just need to dodge the attacks and stock up on fire resistance potions.
